payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly echoes the existing Sprint 4 retro content: the async decision widget shipped (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture), velocity of 23 points (Obs_TinaVelocity, StyleObs metric-anchored claims), and Zephyr integration as key unlock (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock). I expanded the full narrative chain — AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionsEvaporate, DecisionCaptureAtConsensus — so the passes can bind this retro to the product thesis rather than minting duplicates. I also included ContextPreservationNextSprint (next sprint focus from the prior retro), WebhookArchitecture (the widget's technical foundation), and both pricing positions ($12 and $15 tier) since they originate from the same sprint retro document and provide supersession context. ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform and TargetMarketRemoteTeams give the passes the category and ICP framing the velocity claim implicitly rests on. I did not expand the People or Dimensions doors as the document is a solo Tanya retro with no new participants or dimensional axes.
